title: Regular Expression Matching
kidExplanation: Picture the puzzle 'Regular Expression Matching'. Here is the clever trick in plain words: The key idea is to use dynamic programming to solve this problem. We create a 2D table 'dp' where dp[i][j] represents whether the first 'i' characters in the string 's' match the first 'j' characters in the pattern 'p'. We will still start slow, then use this trick so it becomes fast.
